title: Grateful Dead Live at Mammoth Gardens on 1970-04-24

ai_review.summary: Mediocre audience recording of an incomplete Denver Fillmore show, interesting mainly as a historical snapshot.
ai_review.review: The tape captures only part of the Mammoth Gardens concert (the former Fillmore on Colfax) and suffers from sub‑par audio quality. While it isn’t a great or complete performance record, fans may still appreciate its place in Denver’s Dead history.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief review with a middling 3‑star rating; both the performance and recording are described as incomplete or not great, leading to an overall below‑average score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Not a great recording; incomplete capture of the show; basic audience tape with limited clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Show is not complete, so set flow cannot be assessed; reviewers note only its historical significance.
